compiled_state.title: As a calibration-program operator, I want calibration-report.sh query <sub> to answer the four named program-health questions, so that ad-hoc investigation does not require parsing rollup comments by hand.
compiled_state.author: Test
compiled_state.description:
Adds the query subcommand family to calibration-report.sh with the four documented sub values: intents-with-low-kill-rate, intents-without-coverage, bugs-by-channel-and-type, rule-effectiveness <rule-id>. Each sub produces output matching its documented schema for a dry-run input fixture. Uses the same on-demand bug/review queries as the monthly/quarterly story plus the pre-aggregated mutation/churn data from the mutation-append story.

Phase F split evaluation: KEEP WHOLE — four query subs share data-access helpers (bug list by tag, mutation history read, churn history read); splitting into Foundation/Enhancement adds coordination overhead without meaningfully reducing per-session scope.

## Done Definitions

- calibration-report.sh query intents-with-low-kill-rate produces output matching its documented schema for a dry-run input fixture ← Satisfies: sc-3
- calibration-report.sh query intents-without-coverage produces output matching its documented schema for a dry-run input fixture ← Satisfies: sc-3
- calibration-report.sh query bugs-by-channel-and-type produces output matching its documented schema for a dry-run input fixture ← Satisfies: sc-3
- calibration-report.sh query rule-effectiveness <rule-id> produces output matching its documented schema for a dry-run input fixture ← Satisfies: sc-3
- Each query sub's schema is documented in the script's --help output and exercised by a fixture-based test ← Satisfies: sc-3

## Considerations

- [Maintainability] The four query subs share common data-access primitives (bug list by tag, mutation history read, churn history read) with monthly/quarterly — extract these into helper functions so the aggregator and queries do not diverge.
- [Reliability] query bugs-by-channel-and-type must use the bug-type-only query path from the contamination-guard story to satisfy sc-2.

## Escalation Policy

Escalate when blocked
